title: Hajj and Umrah Step-by-Step
description: Complete guide to Hajj (حج) and Umrah (عمرة) pilgrimage step by step, based on the authentic Sunnah. Learn the rites from leaving your home to returning, with detailed explanations of each pillar and condition.
short_description: Your complete step-by-step guide to performing Hajj and Umrah

modules.title: Umrah: The Lesser Pilgrimage
modules.description: Step-by-step guide to performing Umrah from leaving home to completion.

lessons.title: Preparation for Umrah
lessons.content: Essential preparations before embarking on Umrah (عمرة), including learning the rites, packing appropriately, and making the intention.

lessons.title: Entering Ihram
lessons.content: How to enter the state of Ihram (إحرام) from the Meeqaat, including the Talbiyah (تلبية) and the rulings of Ihram.

lessons.title: Tawaf and Sa'i
lessons.content: Performing Tawaf (طواف) - circumambulation of the Ka'bah - and Sa'i (سعي) between Safa and Marwa.

lessons.title: Shaving or Trimming the Hair
lessons.content: The ruling of Halq (حلق) - shaving - or Taqsir (تقصير) - trimming - the hair, and exiting the state of Ihram.

modules.title: Hajj: The Greater Pilgrimage
modules.description: Step-by-step guide to performing Hajj in the days of Dhul-Hijjah.

lessons.title: The Types of Hajj
lessons.content: Understanding the three types of Hajj: Tamattu' (تمتع), Qiran (قران), and Ifrad (إفراد), and which type is best.

lessons.title: The Days of Hajj (8th-9th Dhul-Hijjah)
lessons.content: The rites of Hajj from the 8th to the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah: entering Ihram, staying in Mina, and standing at Arafah (عرفة).

lessons.title: The Day of Sacrifice (10th Dhul-Hijjah)
lessons.content: The rites of the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah: stoning the Jamarat (رمي الجمرات), sacrifice (نحر), shaving the head, and Tawaf al-Ifadah.

lessons.title: The Days of Tashreeq
lessons.content: The rites of the 11th-13th of Dhul-Hijjah: staying in Mina, stoning the Jamarat, and the farewell Tawaf (وداع).
